players.bio: Aidan Borland is a 19-year-old Scottish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL League Two club Accrington Stanley F.C., on loan from Premier League club Aston Villa F.C.
Alex William Henderson (born 25 September 2004) is an English footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Accrington Stanley.
Charlie Daniel Brown (born 23 September 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Accrington Stanley.
Charlie Caton is a 23-year-old Welsh professional footballer who plays as a forward for Accrington Stanley F.C. in EFL League Two.

Charlie Roy Benjamin Warren (born 24 January 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for Accrington Stanley, on loan from EFL Championship club Bolton Wanderers. Career After playing for Ipswich Town, Needham Market and Felixstowe & Walton United, he signed for Bolton Wanderers in June 2025.
Cole John Stockton is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Accrington Stanley.
Connor O'Brien (born 12 July 2004) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Accrington Stanley.

Conor James Grant (born 18 April 1995) is an English footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Accrington Stanley. A former England under-18 international, Grant turned professional at Everton in July 2013.
David Tutonda is a 31-year-old Congolese professional footballer who currently plays as a defender (primarily left-back or centre-back) for Accrington Stanley in EFL League Two.
Devon William Matthews (born 4 January 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Accrington Stanley.

Donald Alistair Love (born 2 December 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Accrington Stanley. Love, who was born in Rochdale, Greater Manchester, joined the Manchester United academy at the age of eight from local team Northwich Town. After rising through the ranks, he first signed a professional contract with Manchester United in 2013.
Farrend James Rawson (born 11 July 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central defender for EFL League Two club Accrington Stanley.
Freddie Sass is a 25-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for National League club Forest Green Rovers F.C..
Isaac Sinclair (born 26 July 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Accrington Stanley.

James Rogerson is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Accrington Stanley F.C.. Wearing the number 21 shirt, he signed his first professional contract with the club in July 2025 after progressing through their youth setup.

Joel Catesby is a 19-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a left winger for League Two club Accrington Stanley, on loan from Everton FC. Known for his pace and ability to play in tight spaces, he is highly regarded as a rising talent within Everton's academy setup.

John Doolan (born 10 November 1968) is an English football ex-player and coach. He is manager of EFL League Two club Accrington Stanley. Born in Liverpool, he played for Wigan Athletic between 1992 and 1996. Having worked at both Liverpool and Everton Academies he was appointed as Wigan's youth team coach in November 2011, following the departure of Dave Watson.
Joseph William Anderson (born 6 February 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Barrow.
Joshua Jack Smith (born 17 September 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Accrington Stanley.
Josh Stanley Ronald Woods (born 5 July 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Accrington Stanley.

Kelsey Thomas Mooney (born 5 February 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Accrington Stanley. Mooney began his career with Aston Villa, turning professional in February 2017. He moved on loan to Cheltenham Town in August 2018.

Liam Christopher Coyle (born 6 December 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays for Accrington Stanley, as a midfielder. Club career Coyle began his career with Liverpool at the age of nine, and spent time on loan in Bolton Wanderers's development squad in 2021. In July 2021 he signed for Accrington Stanley.
Louie Paul Moulden (born 6 January 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Accrington Stanley, on loan from EFL Championship club Norwich City.

Séamus Conneely (born 9 July 1988) is an Irish footballer who plays as a right back for Accrington Stanley. He has previously played for Galway United, Sheffield United and Alfreton Town. He was born in London, but moved with his parents to Connemara. Conneely was capped for Ireland at several youth levels from under-17s and made his under-21s début against Switzerland in October 2009.

Shaun James Whalley (born 7 August 1987) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Accrington Stanley. Born in Prescot, Merseyside, Whalley played for Norwich City and Southport as a youth before making his Football League debut with Chester City in 2004.
Stefan Edouard Mols is a 27-year-old Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Accrington Stanley F.C. in EFL League Two.
Born in 1999, Tom Moore is a 27-year-old English professional centre-back. He plays as a defender for Accrington Stanley F.C. in League Two.
Tyler Walton (born 23 September 1998) is an English footballer who plays for EFL League Two side Accrington Stanley as a winger.
